items.title: Hinton Milt — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewee describes Chick Webb's playing style and interactions with other musicians (Chew Barry, Benny Carter) but does not state a direct personal or professional relationship with Chick Webb himself.

ctx.x: Yes, he was… because before that we had band arrangements and some of the guys in the band, including Benny Payton were making arrangements and they wasn‟t quite up to what Chick Webb was playing and Chick was swinging.
